title: Katie's of Smithtown
venue_description:
Overview

Katie's of Smithtown occupies one of the oldest standing buildings in Smithtown and has earned a reputation as Long Island's most famous haunted bar. The house spirit known as Charlie the Ghost is part of the local lore and adds to the character of this two-floor Irish pub on Main Street.

Music Programming

Tuesday Nights

Tuesdays are reserved for a regular solo performer giving the room a consistent early-week live music option.

Wednesday Open Mic and Arts Night

Wednesdays turn the room over to an open mic and arts night produced with Equilibrium Booking. Sign-ups are in person starting at 8:30 PM and the night runs until 2:30 AM. A house backline of guitar amp bass amp and drum kit is provided so any musician can hop up and play. The night is known for welcoming original songwriters alongside cover players and other performing artists.

Friday and Saturday Nights

Weekends bring full live bands to the stage backed by what reviewers consistently call one of the best sound systems on Long Island.

Atmosphere and Amenities

Katie's spans two floors with dark wood interiors a large outdoor patio and a frequent late-night food truck for midnight bites. Reviewers highlight the strong sense of community friendly staff and lively but relaxed crowd that keeps regulars coming back.

Practical Information

Katie's of Smithtown remains open and active with a full weekly live entertainment calendar as of the most recent listings and continues to be a hub for Smithtown's local music scene.
